TITLE: Technician Utilization report – "Utilization %" Shows Two Decimal Places Instead of One
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-8649 (Tech Util - Story 2 - Columns and Calculations; Done) · PRIORITY: Medium · LINK: relates to SV-8649, relates to SV-9059, relates to SV-9407
STATUS: HELD — NOT FILED. Waiting for the product owner's answer to WQ-2. SV-9059 (Done) asked for two decimals and SV-9407 (same symptom as this ticket) was closed OBSOLETE without a comment, while the specification still says one decimal. File only if the PO confirms "one decimal".
BASIS: Technician Utilization specification, Confluence 641400833, version 9 (13 Aug 2026), read live 28 Oct 2026.
REPRODUCED: twice on staging build v26.43.2-f8698cb, 28 Oct 2026 (DVI Test and Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).

h2. Description

*Every value in the Utilization % column, and the Summary row, is shown with two decimal places (for example 85.71%). The specification asks for one decimal place (85.7%).*

*Impact:* display only; the underlying percentage is correct (WO hours ÷ Total hours, checked on every row).

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin. In the top bar, choose the location *DVI Test*.
# Open *Reports* > *Technician Utilization*.
# Leave *Date* on *This month*.
# Find the row *Esther Howard*.
#* *Utilization %* reads *85.71%* (Total Hours 3.50, WO Hours 3.00).
# Look at the *Summary* row at the bottom.
#* *Utilization %* reads *90.12%*.

*Actual Result:*
* Utilization % is shown with two decimals: 85.71%, 90.12%.

*Expected Result:*
* Utilization % is shown with one decimal, rounded half up: 85.7%, 90.1%.
